heading.title: Of Offences By or Relating to Public Servants

article.title: Public servant unlawfully engaging in trade
article.content: Whoever, being a public servant, and being legally bound as such public servant not to engage in trade, engages in trade, shall be punished with simple imprisonment for a term which may extend to one year, or with fine, or with both or with community service.
article.html:
202Public servant unlawfully engaging in trade

Section 202 · Chapter XII

Whoever, being a public servant, and being legally bound as such public servant not to engage in trade, engages in trade, shall be punished with simple imprisonment for a term which may extend to one year, or with fine, or with both or with community service.
